answer: Fireclay and grog lie in heaps by the crucible-maker's bench. quartz rams the clay into the mould and turns it out. Proof of crucible-maker via fired crucible tally — a crucible the crucible-maker fires only after 1459 crucibles hold true without one crucible cracking at the lip, each fired by the crucible-maker himself. kernel dries it slow and fires it. canyon tests it with molten brass. One thousand four hundred and fifty-nine crucibles must hold true without one crucible cracking at the lip, and the next still cracks where the clay ran short of grog.
